instruction: Sort the data in the spreadsheet by the Date Time column in descending order (latest to earliest).

metadata.explanation: Task requires sorting data by Date Time in descending order (latest first). Verified with Python that the latest date (2015-12-20) has product 'Fun Fly' from 'coloradoboomerangs.com'. Evaluator checks cells C2 and B2.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Only checks 2 cells (B2 and C2) to verify entire dataset sorting
Does not verify sorting logic: Evaluator only checks that the maximum date row is at top, not that all rows are in descending date order
Weak verification: A partially sorted or incorrectly sorted dataset could pass if the top row happens to be correct
Missing comprehensive sorting check: Should verify multiple rows or compare date values to ensure monotonic descending order throughout the dataset
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add multiple check_cell rules to verify dates in rows 2, 3, 4, etc. are in descending order
Use sheet_data comparison against a pre-sorted expected file to verify complete sorting
Add checks to compare Date Time column values across multiple rows to ensure proper descending order (e.g., date[row2] >= date[row3] >= date[row4])
